subject: Recast MAP & revised closure runway — Acme Systems
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@acme.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 20:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timelines

Mateo —

Quick note from procurement: our internal budget approvals are delayed two weeks. That puts our internal eval window back and likely pushes the acceptance milestone by ~10 business days. We still want to proceed, but we need an updated mutual action plan and a clear list of delivery gates so we can align our procurement and security reviews.

Can you share a revised MAP with adjusted target dates and any recommended contingency lanes (e.g., interim pilot vs full roll)? Also, what flex do you have on the start date for the Dedicated trial if procurement finishes late?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Platform Integrations | Acme Systems

---
Attachments: none
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timelines

Samir — thanks for the heads up and appreciate the transparency. We can absolutely accommodate a rebaseline.

Immediate plan: I drafted a short recast of the MAP with two paths — Standard (procurement on original schedule) and Contingency (procurement delayed). The Contingency lane shifts the acceptance milestone by 10 business days and preserves the pilot-start by routing to a scoped Dedicated pilot (reduced capacity) to keep momentum. I've attached "Acme_MAP-v2.pdf" and a tracked-changes SOW.

Key asks from our side to lock the new runway:
- Confirmation of the new procurement target date from your procurement lead (Priya)
- A final list of success metrics for the pilot (latency, throughput, eval prompts) by Apr 28
- One-week window for a technical cutover dry-run before the pilot start

We can be flexible on the Dedicated trial start by up to 14 days if necessary, but a hard push beyond that starts to encroach on the quarter plan and would require an executive cadence change. Laura and Karthik are looped for pricing/contract buffers and technical gating.

I'll follow up with a short risk register and owner assignments this afternoon.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Acme_MAP-v2.pdf, SOW-draft-acme.docx
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timelines — internal note

Team — quick internal note to record the commercial constraints:

Risk log (short):
- R1: Procurement delay (likelihood: high). Impact: push to acceptance milestone, potential Q2/3 revenue slip. Owner: Mateo.
- R2: Security evidence turnaround (likelihood: med). Impact: block pilot start. Owner: Karthik.
- R3: Contract negotiation on usage caps (likelihood: low-med). Impact: pricing concession pressure. Owner: Laura.

Mitigations:
- Offer a scoped Dedicated pilot (reduced vGPU count) with fixed pilot pricing for 30 days to keep product validation on schedule.
- Pre-populate security artifacts and run a targeted SOC snapshot to reduce back-and-forth. Karthik can own the checklist.
- Reserve a one-time exec credit (up to 10% of first-month committed spend) as leverage if procurement needs a commercial trigger. Approval: Laura.

I'll prepare an updated risk register with dates and owners and drop it into the Drive folder Mateo mentioned. Mateo, after Samir confirms the new procurement date, let's set a short exec sync (15') to realign expectations.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations

Mateo / team —

Thanks — confirmed procurement is targeting May 12 for final approval (internal finance sign-off complete this week). That aligns with your contingency lane. We'll put together the pilot success metrics and have them to you by Apr 28 as requested.

One ask from Acme: can the pilot include an explicit acceptance criterion around 95th percentile latency at 2K token sequences? We want that measured on our test harness. If Redwood can provide a short-run report during the pilot week (day 3), that would help us fast-track the acceptance decision.

Priya Menon
VP, Procurement & Vendor Strategy | Acme Systems

Subject: Re: MAP draft and timelines — updated action register and next steps

Priya / Samir — great, thanks for the procurement target. Confirming next steps and owners (short):

1) Mateo: Publish the updated MAP (Acme_MAP-v2.pdf) with two lanes (Standard / Contingency) and a one-page summary of gating criteria — by EOD Apr 26 (done; see Drive link).
2) Priya: Final procurement approval target: May 12 (Acme) — please flag if anything changes.
3) Karthik: Security checklist and SOC snapshot request — kick-off Apr 27; provide artifacts by May 3.
4) Samir: Pilot success metrics (including 95th pctl latency at 2K) — due Apr 28.
5) Laura: Commercial buffer — hold proposed exec credit; confirm by May 4 if needed.

Contingency specifics: If procurement misses May 12 by more than 5 business days, we trigger the reduced-capacity Dedicated pilot on May 20 with an internal dry-run on May 18. All dates are in the MAP.

I'll also open a short record in HubSpot (deal ACME-2026-47) and attach the MAP + SOW. If everyone is aligned I'll schedule a 15' exec alignment for May 6 to confirm escalation posture.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Mateo Alvarez
